prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design audio-session behavior for an iPhone language lesson. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Starting a silent flashcard stops the user’s music, narration continues after explicit Pause and interruption by a call restarts the lesson from the beginning at full volume. Captions/transcript data exist.
